title: Printers & scanners
blurb: Offline, stuck jobs, wrong printer, scanning.

remedies.title: Print double-sided, in black and white, or several pages per sheet
remedies.why: These are print-dialog options; their names vary by printer.

steps.text: In the print dialog open Printer properties / More settings: Print on both sides, Color › Black & white, Pages per sheet.
Mac: the Layout section has Two-Sided and Pages per Sheet; Printer Options for colour.
Set them as defaults in the printer's Printing preferences.

remedies.title: Save as PDF instead of printing
remedies.why: Both systems can "print" to a PDF file.

steps.text: Pick "Microsoft Print to PDF" as the printer.
Click PDF › Save as PDF in the print dialog.
If Microsoft Print to PDF is missing, turn it on in Windows features.
DeskFolio (a sister DeskLab app) can merge, compress and sign the result.

remedies.title: Connect a new printer to Wi-Fi
remedies.why: Printers join Wi-Fi from their own screen, a button (WPS), or the maker's app.

steps.text: On the printer's screen: Settings › Wireless › Setup wizard › pick the network and type its password.
No screen: use the maker's app (HP Smart, Epson Smart Panel, Canon PRINT, Brother iPrint) which walks through it.
Or press WPS on the router, then the printer's Wi-Fi button within 2 minutes.
After a new router, every printer has to join the new network.

remedies.title: Printer refuses to print: ink, cartridge or "unsupported supply"
remedies.why: Printers stop for empty or unrecognised cartridges; some reject non-original ones after firmware updates.

steps.text: Take the cartridge out, check the protective tape is off and the contacts are clean, and click it back in.
Check the exact cartridge model fits the printer.
Some printers let you continue in black only or ignore low-ink warnings from their menu.

remedies.title: Printing is very slow
remedies.why: Large or image-heavy documents, high-quality mode, or a weak Wi-Fi link to the printer.

steps.text: Choose Draft/Normal quality instead of Best for everyday printing.
Print large PDFs as images only if needed (Advanced › Print as image).
Clear the queue and restart the spooler.
Move the printer closer to the router or connect it by cable.

remedies.title: Office copier "scan to email" or "scan to folder" stopped working
remedies.why: The copier's saved email or folder login no longer works (a password changed or older security was turned off).

steps.text: Note the error on the copier's screen.
Use scan to USB stick as a stopgap.

remedies.escalate: IT or the copier company must update the copier's saved login or folder settings.

remedies.title: Add a printer by IP address on a Mac
remedies.why: Printers on another network segment don't appear automatically.

steps.text: Printers & Scanners › Add Printer › the globe (IP) tab › type the address, Protocol: AirPrint or IPP.
Choose the right driver under Use if it doesn't pick one.
